question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Wisedom**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Wisedom**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Wisdom**'. • It means 'the ability to make sensible decisions and judgements because of your knowledge or experience'. [(ज्ञान या अनुभव के आधार पर) विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने की क्षमता, समझदारी, बुद्धिमानी, अक़लमंदी] • *Example: I don’t see the **wisdom**** **of this plan [I do not think that it is a good idea].* **Correct Answer:__** *Wisedom.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Freedom**: the state of not being held prisoner or controlled by somebody else. (स्‍वतंत्रता, आज़ादी; दूसरे की क़ैद या नियंत्रण से मुक्ति) • **Boredom**: the state of being bored. (ऊब, बोरियत, अरुचि, नीरसता) • **Kingdom**: a country that is ruled by a king or queen. (राजा या रानी द्वारा शासित देश; राज्‍य) 36:T64f, The correct answer is '**sea**'.
